title: AWS Stammtisch - sponsored by Labyrinth Labs
summary: Date: August 7, 2025 Time: Starting from 18:00 Location: Flanagans Irish Pub, Schwarzenbergstraße 1/3, 1010 Vienna
description:
Join us for a **Special Summer Meetup**!

Date: August 7, 2025
Time: Starting from 18:00
Location: Flanagans Irish Pub, Schwarzenbergstraße 1/3, 1010 Vienna

We're excited to invite you to a unique summer gathering, a collaborative event hosted by the AWS User Group Vienna and the AWS User Group Bratislava. This event breaks away from our usual format to offer an evening of fun, discussions, and friendly competition.

**Event Highlights:**

* **18:00 onwards:** Arrival and networking. Enjoy drinks courtesy of our sponsor, [Labyrinth Labs](https://lablabs.io).
* **19:00 - 20:00:** Pub Quiz! Test your AWS knowledge and compete for amazing prizes. The top three teams will win AWS credits: 1st Place: $75, 2nd Place: $50, 3rd Place: $25

**Please note:** This meetup will not feature any formal talks. Instead, it's a relaxed evening designed to foster connections and engage in informal discussions about all things AWS.

Mark your calendars and get ready for an evening of networking, fun, and a chance to win some great prizes!
\-\-\-
**Agenda:**

* **18:00:** Doors open, drinks and networking
* **18:50 - 19:00:** Community intro and introduction to the sponsor
* **19:00 - 20:00:** Pub Quiz
* **20:00 - Open End:** More networking and discussions

\-\-\-
With your RSVP, you confirm that you agree to our [code of conduct](http://aws-meetup-vie.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/AWS_Meetup_Vienna-Code_Of_Conduct.pdf).
Looking forward to seeing you there!

**Event Sponsor:**
[Labyrinth Labs](https://lablabs.io) \- Proudly sponsoring the drinks for the evening\.
